EU: In a research report issued on Thursday, 26 July, JPMorgan reconfirmed their “Overweight” rating on Facebook (FB) shares. They now have a $205.0 PT on the company. JPMorgan’s target means a potential downside of -5.75 % from the company’s current stock price.
The stock decreased 18.96% or $41.24 $176.26. About 164.82 million shares traded or 586.30% up from the average. Facebook, Inc. (FB) has risen 21.69% since July 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Facebook, Inc. provides various products to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, and other surfaces worldwide. $510.21 billion. The Company’s solutions include Facebook Website and mobile application that enables people to connect, share, discover, and communicate each other on mobile devices and personal computers; Instagram, a mobile application that enables people to take photos or videos, customize them with filter effects, and share them with friends and followers in a photo feed or send them directly to friends; Messenger, a messaging application to communicate with people and businesses across platforms and devices; and WhatsApp Messenger, a mobile messaging application. It has a 29.18 P/E ratio. The firm also offers Oculus virtual reality technology and content platform, which allow people to enter an immersive and interactive environment to play games, consume content, and connect with others.
